dedupe_keys.name: friuli venezia giulia landscape plan historic architectural property contexts

description: The Friuli Venezia Giulia landscape plan (PPR) records alphanumeric attributes and parcel geometries associated with historic architectural properties and their surrounding landscape contexts. Native entries comprise the UC additional-context layer in dataset, WMS and WFS representations and a companion property layer labelled Part II of Legislative Decree 42/2004. They share the PPR publisher, full source description and explicit property subject, but their legal categories and spatial extents are not assumed identical. The geometry describes parcels and contexts around historic assets; it is not established as building footprints. The source calls the database informational and states that published perimeters have no legal value. Exact protection boundaries require the individual legal acts. Two fields named interesse and appartenenza were added in September 2023 and also inserted into the historical views without changing earlier columns. Metadata lists Shapefile and OGC access. The WMS entry specifies CC BY 4.0; the other three state public data without precise reuse terms, so uniform licensing is not established. File-use costs, current building condition and specific simulation uses remain unknown. The paired services represent the UC layer and do not add separate datasets. No feature, archive, map or legal-document body was read.
